title: OmniForge Web Adapter App Manifest v1
description: Consumed only by the web-static adapter, referenced from a project's targets.web.entry.

seo.description: All optional. See docs/seo.md for exactly what each field produces and this adapter's honest single-page scope.

site_url.description: Absolute base URL this page is deployed at, e.g. https://example.com. Required to generate sitemap.xml and the default canonical URL; without it, both are honestly skipped rather than written with a guessed or relative URL.

canonical_url.description: Overrides the canonical URL; defaults to site_url if omitted.

og_image.description: Absolute URL or a path under public/assets/ for the Open Graph image.

robots.description: The <meta name=robots> content attribute, e.g. 'index, follow' (default) or 'noindex, nofollow'.
